data.name: Jehika
data.gender_notes: Jehika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jehika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya' meaning victory and 'Ka' meaning wealth. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. The name Jehika carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jehika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance and prosperity in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Jehika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wealth and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jehika total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
